primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: AEs were graded according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Version 4.03, June 2010. Grades: mild - the event is easily tolerated by the participant and does not affect the participant's usual daily activities; moderate - the event causes the participant more discomfort and interrupts the participant's usual daily activities; severe - the event is incapacitating and causes considerable interference with the participant's usual daily activities.
